description: Finds other Bible passages that relate to a given verse, ranked by how widely the link is attested. This answers "what else in Scripture speaks to this?" — the standard next step in study after reading a verse. Returns each related passage with its text, so no follow-up lookup is needed.

include_text.description: Whether to include the text of each related passage. Default true. Set false for a compact list of references only.

limit.description: Maximum number of related passages. Default: 10; max: 25.

reference.description: The verse to start from, such as "John 3:16" or "Romanos 8:28". Must point at a single verse; a whole chapter is too broad for cross-references.

version.description: Optional Bible version slug for the text of the related passages. Defaults to the connection version, or "bsb" (English).

name: get_cross_references

copyright.description: Attribution the version license requires (e.g. CC BY-SA). Present only for versions that need it; show it with the text.

votes.description: How many sources attest this link. Higher is stronger.
